claim_comment: Defining a topology-neutral compatible handshake that independently verifies registration, provider/build/state identity, exact scope, capabilities, finite limits, deadline, and live cancellation before readiness or provider effects.
acceptance_criteria: Handshake independently verifies provider, registration, implementation, protocol, state-owner/schema, and exact coding-scope identity before readiness.
Capabilities and every operational limit are negotiated explicitly and fail closed for missing, unknown, zero, overflowed, or incompatible values.
Deadline and live cancellation propagate to the concrete provider operation; expired or already-cancelled requests terminate before provider contact.
Readiness is an expiring scoped receipt, never inferred from process/socket/path/state existence, and handshake has no provider, TraceDecay, Native-fact, or context side effects.
close_reason: Accepted the topology-neutral V1 provider handshake contract with independent compatibility checks, exact scope/state ownership, finite lower-ceiling limits, real deadline/cancellation, read-only semantics, and expiring readiness receipts.
close_comment: Evidence: product/contracts/memory-provider-v1/provider-handshake-contract.json, strict top-level JSON Schema, and explanatory Markdown define protocol 1.0 compatibility, canonical request/response fields, implementation artifact/license/provenance identity, provider-local state owner/schema/scope identity, exact profile/project/repository/worktree/branch/session scope, eight finite limit dimensions, min(host,provider) negotiation, absolute plus monotonic deadlines, live cancellation, ten deterministic compatibility steps, twenty-two typed readiness states, and a scoped nonportable ready receipt. Process existence, socket, database path, non-empty state, runtime location, wildcards, CWD inference, cross-major downgrade, zero/unbounded limits, deadline extension, cancellation-as-success, provider mutation, TraceDecay mutation, Native fact mutation, context injection, and silent fallback are all forbidden. scripts/product/check-provider-handshake-contract.py cross-checks exact fields, algorithms, bounds, Beads IDs, registry slots, schema, docs, and NCM/OCEAN gates; tests/product_provider_handshake_contract_test.py injects identity, scope, protocol, limit, deadline, cancellation, side-effect, readiness, receipt, Beads, and schema failures.
